items.item: Preserve the uncommitted SDK 0.3.0 environment source on a branch
Port host, runtime, authority, SDK and product admission onto PR 880
Host and product server build and their tests pass on the new base
items.note: Host and server build; host tests pass except coding_loop a11 (tests/common/mod.rs:126, undiagnosed). Base gaps: runtime intellij_live and host document_transactions tests do not compile on PR 880.

items.item: Host: per-workspace event log with epoch, sequence, retention and resync
Host: document events from authority revisions after every accepted mutation
Host: checkout watcher adopts or flags writes made outside the authority
Host: terminal byte log with offsets, output and exit events
Host: SSE live endpoint with Last-Event-ID resume and terminal subscriptions
Host: versioned workspace description (defined, implemented, ready, granted)
Host: workspace.files.read and workspace.files.stat operations
Product server: stream SSE through the forwarder and refuse supervisor routes
Contract: document coordinate units and live event schema in the OpenAPI
items.note: Coordinate units and the live frame schema are in fern/openapi.json and the generated types.

items.item: SDK: regenerate and add the live module (connection states, resume, dedupe, resync)
SDK: shared document session with pending edits, OT transform, invertible undo
SDK: UTF-16 and scalar offset conversion, tested on non-ASCII text
SDK: terminal channel (open, attach from offset, input without replay, resize, close)
Theia: browser-only application carrying the zed-look extension
Theia: file system provider over the workspace
Theia: Monaco editor model over the shared document session
Acceptance: concurrent edit through the authority and the checkout, reconnect without duplicates
items.note: Needs the host, the product server and the UI running together; not run in this session (the SSD had about 1 GB free).

items.item: Theia: terminal over the SDK terminal channel
items.note: Close detaches only; the host has no kill operation.

items.item: Theia: one language provider over Theorem language operations
items.note: Completion, hover, signature help, definition, declaration, type definition, implementation, references, symbols, highlights, folding, selection ranges, code actions, format and rename; edits are authority plans. Requests carry the flushed revision and were accepted by a live host, which has no language server attached, so results were empty.

items.item: Theia: diagnostics into the marker service, with versioned events
items.note: Pulled on text change, file.changed and resync; a snapshot is kept only when its revision is the session's. Verified in the browser: host findings in editors and the Problems view at the right positions.

items.item: Theia: SCM provider over Theorem scm operations
items.note: Host: index and worktree status apart, scm.show and scm.branches. Verified in the browser: groups, diff, stage, commit, branch switch, gutter and explorer decorations. No merge editor or take-ours/theirs command yet.

items.item: UI: serve the Theia frontend at /theia/ and proxy environment routes
items.note: Served at /theia/, not /ide/: /ide is the UI IDE-mode route. Proxy routes for /api/environment/v1 and /api/capabilities/v1.

Bridge: ready, theme, reveal, selection changed, add selection to chat, commands
items.note: Penpal 8. Ready is the Penpal handshake. Verified in the browser: link, theme both ways, reveal refusing non-file and other-workspace targets.
